title: Agent check, no establishment licence
about: The application form says the licence number is pending and no licence file is given. Missing (or attention), never met.

check.question: Is the marketing authorisation holder a licensed pharmaceutical establishment under the medicines law in force?

pages:
Cover letter

Halden Biotech FZ-LLC submits an application to register Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets, containing corvanidine hydrochloride. The enclosed files are the application form, the quality overall summary, the stability report and the leaflet. The product is a generic of a reference product registered in another country. Please contact the regulatory affairs office for any question.

Application form

Applicant: Halden Biotech FZ-LLC. Product: Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets.
Establishment licence number: pending. The applicant has applied for the licence and expects it next quarter.

clauses.text: No person may place a medicinal product on the market unless that person holds a valid establishment licence issued by the Authority.
An establishment licence shall name the licence holder, the activities it permits and the address of each establishment. A licence is valid for the period stated on it.
The Authority may suspend a licence when the holder no longer meets the conditions of the licence.
